It wouldn't take whole countries' governments. It would take a set of doctors. If we wanted to be really specific, it wouldn't even take that. It would only take a set of doctors who had received a test they've been told by the manufacturers (or some large body like the NIH) identifies Corona. It's the test that is detecting Corona. A so-called "conspiracy" often doesn't require what you think it does. Just the first few dominoes. Then it feeds itself.

So we've gone from only needing a set of doctors in each nation to only requiring a test that identifies something, perhaps something like a flu or respiratory tract infection as Corona.

No collusion. Just the same average people operating on the same information. For all you know, this test could produce false positives half of the time, and nobody else would know that either (do you have any peer-reviewed publicly accessible research that has shown specificity and reliability tests on the test?). The doctors are just running the tests, operating with confidence on the authority of the test producer who was vetted by that big group, like the NIH.
